lore.description: A boy, Trailblazer, decides to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron.
stories:
You don't remember much.
You're not from around here, nor did you come from elsewhere. You're not really going anywhere—
Just then, that indistinct voice whispers into your ear. That sorrowful and tender persuasion, that deceptive goading...
The seeds take root. You open your eyes, and the speaker is no longer there.

But there are more and more voices, and they are getting clearer and clearer.
Some give easygoing care, some calmly provide advice, some speak firm support, and some gift gentle direction...
You see the silken thread being woven to form tomorrow.

A huge beast descends from infinity,
golden pupils stare down from the darkness,
and you are no longer abandoned by the past.
You will also set upon a long journey,
and the thorns you have stepped on have become your path.

The train whistles, wishing you a successful journey to the coming future
...by your own will.

You have arrived at the "City of Preservation."
Behind the snow curtain, the wind lashes like steel blades, but the kindling burns on.
Distant lands won't hear them, and the earth trembles in kind, with only the wailing crowds braving the wind.

After facing foreign enemies, the Eternal Freeze, and reality's fissures, a rot begins to fester within the fort.
You try lending a helping hand, but are forsaken.
Some once looked down on you and misunderstood you, but still you stood by their side and helped them find their way.
More care about you and worry about you. They face their suffering, and find the cure for the distressed.
Eventually, they come to your side.

In the ice and snow, you are like a fire, protecting the soul of this world
...Even though you must scorch yourself day and night.

The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

Look, in The Eternal Land, a nameless epic unfolds.
Listen. The wind's ballad sings the elegy of Era Nova, and witnesses the golden blood flowing through slumbering flowers, as the Coreflames sustain the scarred earth.
Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

For false endings shackle the story's beginning.
Count the cold fluorescent lights, sting the eyes that pray for dawn.
Time has yet to flow, the sun is set to die. Is this the story's climax, or the finale?
No, there's still... one final stroke.

And so you leave traces of "Trailblaze" on every page, where falls turn into ascents on another end.
You race through the mire of memories, using billions of Coreflames to scorch the frigid data sequences, and catching the shattered seed germs.
When a new blank page appears, you make your mark. It, too, will form ripples toward the past.

Glimmering lights twinkle in the night sky of blank memories, where a shooting star yet to come has been entrusted with the anticipation of eternity.
Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."

You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses.
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall.
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game.
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes.
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on?
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain.
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high.
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness.
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark.
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like.
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.

— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on?

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain.

eidolons.desc:

basic.name: Leave It to Me!
basic.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.desc: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP by an amount equal to {0}% of Mem's Max HP, and grants Mem 10% Charge.

ult.name: Together, Mem!
ult.desc: Summons memosprite Mem. Grants Mem 40% Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Almighty Companion
talent.desc: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of 130 and a Max HP equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's Max HP plus {1}. For every 10 Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

extra.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
extra.desc: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's ATK and {1}% of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains 10% Charge.

extra.name: I Choose You!
extra.desc: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem Charge.

extra.name: Baddies! Trouble!
extra.desc: Deals 4 instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Mem's ATK to one random enemy. At the end, deals Ice DMG equal to {1}% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

extra.name: Friends! Together!
extra.desc:
Increases all allies' CRIT DMG by an amount equal to {0}% of Mem's CRIT DMG plus {1}%.
If the Charge has yet to reach 100%, Mem automatically uses "Baddies! Trouble!" when taking action. When the Charge reaches 100%, Mem immediately takes action. In the next action, can select one ally and use "Lemme! Help You!".

extra.name: Go, Mem, Go!
extra.desc: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains 50% Charge.

extra.name: No... Regrets
extra.desc: When Mem disappears, Trailblazer's action advances by 25%.

extra.name: Lemme! Help You!
extra.desc:
Advances the action of one designated ally by 100% and grants them "Mem's Support," lasting for 3 turn(s).
For every 1 instance of DMG dealt by a target that has "Mem's Support," additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to {0}% of the original DMG.
When using this ability on this unit, cannot trigger the action advance effect.

technique.name: Memories Back as Echoes
technique.desc:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 10 second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.
After entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, delays the action of all enemies by 50%, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 100% of Trailblazer's ATK.
Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ability_1.name: Rhapsode's Scepter
ability_1.desc: When the battle starts, Trailblazer's action advances by 30%. When Mem is first summoned, grants Mem 40% Charge.

ability_2.name: Petite Parable
ability_2.desc: When using "Baddies! Trouble!," Mem immediately gains 5% Charge.

ability_3.name: Magnets and Long Chains
ability_3.desc: When the Max Energy of an ally target that has "Mem's Support" exceeds 100, for every 10 excess Energy, additionally increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt via "Mem's Support" by 2%, up to a max increase of 20%.

extra.name: Unfinished Epilogue
extra.desc: After using Ultimate, gains 1 stack of "Epic," up to 2 stacks. When this unit has "Epic" and Mem is on the field, Basic ATK gets enhanced to "Together, We Script Tomorrow!"

eidolons.name: Gleaner of the Past
eidolons.desc: When ally memosprites (aside from Mem) take action, Trailblazer regenerates 8 Energy. This effect can trigger a max of 1 time(s) per turn. The trigger count resets at the start of Trailblazer's turn.

eidolons.name: Chanter of the Future
eidolons.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Dancer of the Muse
eidolons.desc: When an ally target with 0 Max Energy actively uses an ability, Mem can also gain 3% Charge, and the multiplier of the True DMG dealt by this target via "Mem's Support" additionally increases by 6%.

eidolons.name: Seamster of the Ode
eidolons.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Bearer of the Revelation
eidolons.desc: Ultimate's CRIT Rate is set at 100%.

basic.desc: Deals Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.desc: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP by an amount equal to {0}% of Mem's Max HP, and grants Mem 10% Charge.

ult.name: Together, Mem!
ult.desc: Summons memosprite Mem. Grants Mem 40% Charge, then makes Mem deal Ice DMG equal to {0}% of Mem's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Almighty Companion
talent.desc: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of 130 and a Max HP equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's Max HP plus {1}. For every 10 Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

extra.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!
extra.desc: Consumes 1 stack of "Epic" to dispel all Crowd Control debuffs on Mem. Trailblazer and Mem launch a Joint ATK, dealing Ice DMG to all enemies equal to {0}% of Trailblazer's ATK and {1}% of Mem's ATK respectively. Then, Mem gains 10% Charge.

extra.name: I Choose You!
extra.desc: Summons the memosprite Mem. If Mem is already on the field, restores Mem's HP, and grants Mem Charge.

technique.name: Memories Back as Echoes
technique.desc:
After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for 10 second(s). Enemies within the Special Dimension are placed in a Time Stop state, halting all their actions.
After entering battle against enemies afflicted with the Time Stop state, delays the action of all enemies by 50%, and then deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to 100% of Trailblazer's ATK.
Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

ability_1.name: Rhapsode's Scepter
ability_1.desc: When the battle starts, Trailblazer's action advances by 30%. When Mem is first summoned, grants Mem 40% Charge.

ability_2.name: Petite Parable
ability_2.desc: When using "Baddies! Trouble!," Mem immediately gains 5% Charge.

ability_3.name: Magnets and Long Chains
ability_3.desc: When the Max Energy of an ally target that has "Mem's Support" exceeds 100, for every 10 excess Energy, additionally increases the multiplier of the True DMG dealt via "Mem's Support" by 2%, up to a max increase of 20%.

extra.name: Unfinished Epilogue
extra.desc: After using Ultimate, gains 1 stack of "Epic," up to 2 stacks. When this unit has "Epic" and Mem is on the field, Basic ATK gets enhanced to "Together, We Script Tomorrow!"

lore.description: A girl, Trailblazer, decides to travel with the Astral Express to eliminate the threat of the Stellaron.
stories:
You don't remember much.
You're not from around here, nor did you come from elsewhere. You're not really going anywhere—
Just then, that indistinct voice whispers into your ear. That sorrowful and tender persuasion, that deceptive goading...
The seeds take root. You open your eyes, and the speaker is no longer there.

But there are more and more voices, and they are getting clearer and clearer.
Some give easygoing care, some calmly provide advice, some speak firm support, and some gift gentle direction...
You see the silken thread being woven to form tomorrow.

A huge beast descends from infinity,
golden pupils stare down from the darkness,
and you are no longer abandoned by the past.
You will also set upon a long journey,
and the thorns you have stepped on have become your path.

The train whistles, wishing you a successful journey to the coming future
...by your own will.

You have arrived at the "City of Preservation."
Behind the snow curtain, the wind lashes like steel blades, but the kindling burns on.
Distant lands won't hear them, and the earth trembles in kind, with only the wailing crowds braving the wind.

After facing foreign enemies, the Eternal Freeze, and reality's fissures, a rot begins to fester within the fort.
You try lending a helping hand, but are forsaken.
Some once looked down on you and misunderstood you, but still you stood by their side and helped them find their way.
More care about you and worry about you. They face their suffering, and find the cure for the distressed.
Eventually, they come to your side.

In the ice and snow, you are like a fire, protecting the soul of this world
...Even though you must scorch yourself day and night.

The harmonious music guides you to stumble into the sweet dream, as syrup and soda fill your throat.
The festival is grand, the crowd boisterous, and strangers cast on disguises to meet up in the dream.
You view to your hearts' desires the wondrous and otherworldly views, and part ways when dewdrops shimmer with the break of dawn —
When the pitch-black midnight has just begun.

The clock hands go tick-tock, and death follows closely like a shadow.
You are placed onto the table as a bargaining chip, but manage to win for yourself the right to uncover the secret.
You bring with you the dreams of the dead and continue on the road that they did not walk, facing the enemies they could not defeat—

The false god rises in the conglomeration of the multitude's wishes, and the unanimous song of the gazillions drowns out your existence.
Those walking on different roads take up each other's hands,
your melodies interweave with each other, faint but imperishable like the lights in a long night.
One after one, people startle awake from their dream. That tiny song finally merges into a deafening roar in the end, tearing free of the dream's curtains.

The eternal sweet dream scatters in a fleeting instant, and you finally understand why people slumber
— They do so towards a dawn freed from dreams.

Look, in The Eternal Land, a nameless epic unfolds.
Listen. The wind's ballad sings the elegy of Era Nova, and witnesses the golden blood flowing through slumbering flowers, as the Coreflames sustain the scarred earth.
Like seeds about to perish, poems fade into obscurity.

For false endings shackle the story's beginning.
Count the cold fluorescent lights, sting the eyes that pray for dawn.
Time has yet to flow, the sun is set to die. Is this the story's climax, or the finale?
No, there's still... one final stroke.

And so you leave traces of "Trailblaze" on every page, where falls turn into ascents on another end.
You race through the mire of memories, using billions of Coreflames to scorch the frigid data sequences, and catching the shattered seed germs.
When a new blank page appears, you make your mark. It, too, will form ripples toward the past.

Glimmering lights twinkle in the night sky of blank memories, where a shooting star yet to come has been entrusted with the anticipation of eternity.
Thirteen heartbeats sing proudly for the Flame-Chase Journey, for that was the land they deeply cherished.
The first page of the story unfolds once more, inscribed with prophecies of life.

Listen! The wind sings a melody, the Seeds of Memory grow among the stars, for
the cosmos now knows the name, "Amphoreus."

You're a hero from beyond, an idol pursued by the masses.
 Some want to put you on a pedestal, while others wait with bated breath for your fall.
 The minute you step into this world, you become the center of attention.

You've been thrust into a game.
 In a time when traffic means everything, spectacle after spectacle unfolds, each vying for more eyes.
 In the end, heroes and clowns are viewed the same, and tragedies are not that different from comedies.

A cacophony of wishes threatens to drown you. Should you laugh, cry, flee, or face it head-on?
 The dice of destiny now rest in your palm. To wear the mask or cast it aside? The choice is always yours.

Laughter is the right of every living being, as is the experience of pain.
 You raise your glow stick like a torch held high.
 To stand at the center of the cosmos, one must possess the power to command the storm.

When met with malice, you still create wishes of kindness.
 Without praise, you light your own way through the dark.
Seeking only truth within, unconcerned with outcomes, you showed everyone what a real hero looks like.
 The world has not failed you. You saw the smiles and tears beneath the masks, the faint glimmers of humanity that still remain...

Just as the Trailblaze basks in starlight, and starts the journey anew from this land.

skill.name: Let the Storm Rage On
skill.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {0}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to all enemies and gains 20 point(s) of "Certified Banger."

ult.name: May the Trailblaze Fly You Starward
ult.desc:
Gains 5 Punchline point(s). Increases the CRIT DMG of one designated ally by {0}% for 3 turn(s), and dispels Crowd Control debuffs on them.
If the target has Elation Skill, they additionally gain 10 point(s) of "Certified Banger" and immediately use their Elation Skill 1 time, taking into account a fixed amount of 20 Punchline point(s). If the target does not have Elation Skill, their action advances by 50%.

talent.name: That Smile Hits Different
talent.desc:
After using an attack, regenerates a fixed amount of 10 Energy and gains 3 Punchline point(s).
When the Trailblazer holds "Certified Banger," their Skill additionally deals {0}% Lightning Elation DMG to all enemies. This DMG is calculated using the highest "Certified Banger" value among all allies.

extra.name: I Said "Elation," Did I Stutter?
extra.desc: Deals 8 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing {0}% Lightning Elation DMG to one random enemy. At last, deals {1}% Lightning Elation DMG, which is split evenly among all enemies.

technique.name: We Are So Back!
technique.desc:
After using Technique, randomly gains 1 of the following effects:
A low chance to gain "Hearty Laughter": Increases Elation by 30%.
A high chance to gain "Irrepressible Laughter": Increases Elation by 20%.
When the next battle begins, increases all allies' Elation stat by the corresponding amount for 3 turn(s).

ability_1.name: On Cloud Nine
ability_1.desc: For every 200 point(s) of Trailblazer's ATK that exceeds 1000, increases this unit's Elation stat by 10.0%, up to a maximum increase of 60.0%.

ability_2.desc: Increases this unit's CRIT Rate by 15%. After using Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.

ability_3.name: Aha, Sic 'Em!
ability_3.desc: After an ally target uses Elation Skill, Trailblazer additionally gains 2 point(s) of "Certified Banger" the next time they use their Skill.

Stellar Jade.lore:
A fleeting gleam arrowing across the night sky. Catch it before it's gone. Maybe it can be used to barter?

"Some say that the lights are wishes of sentient beings. While insignificant and elusive, they did light up the pocket of sky around them, right?"

Credit.desc: This currency, used by the Interastral Peace Corporation to settle accounts with its customers, is now widely accepted as the hard currency for space travel.
Credit.lore: "People run around fighting and trading for numbers in a terminal, but the truly precious cannot be bought."

Oneiric Shard.lore: Crystallized lights floating in the sea of stars, pulsing with the residual dream of an ancient leviathan. Everything of the old world turned in the end into candlelight that illuminates the darkness ahead.

Trailblaze Power.desc:
Trailblaze Power will constantly regenerate at a rate of 1 point every 6 minutes to a max of 300 points. You may exchange Stellar Jade for Trailblaze Power.
When Trailblaze Power has been fully regenerated or exceeds the maximum accumulation amount, it will no longer regenerate. At the same time, Reserved Trailblaze Power will begin to regenerate over time.
Trailblaze Power.lore:
The Imaginary power residing in the engines of the Astral Express that protects travelers on the Path of Trailblaze.

"Explore, understand, establish, and connect — that is what it means to trailblaze. Akivili may have fallen, but THEIR legacy continues!"

Reserved Trailblaze Power.desc:
When Trailblaze Power reaches or exceeds the max limit, Reserved Trailblaze Power will begin to regenerate over time. Reserved Trailblaze Power recovers 1 point every 18 minutes for a max of 2400 points.
Reserved Trailblaze Power can withdraw an equivalent amount of Trailblaze Power for a max of 300 points each time.
Reserved Trailblaze Power.lore:
Reserve resources for the Express that functions as a reliable safeguard for the trailblazing expedition.

"Resource reserves. Hmm, do we have reserves of reserves? Such was {NICKNAME}'s question."

EXP.desc: The depths of memory, proof of growth.
EXP.lore: "I am not Fuli... I only believe in myself, for the path of immortality never ends."

Trailblaze EXP.desc: A measure of your Trailblaze Progress. Accumulate Trailblaze EXP to increase Trailblaze Level.

Trailblaze Timer.desc: Permanently increase max Technique Points by 1.
Trailblaze Timer.lore:
The Relic of a Nameless. An item that might have been a pocket watch or a compass.
It is said that the first part to break was the chain. It suddenly snapped during a warp jump, the links scattering everywhere.
Then, it was the back. Hit by a lead bullet, it was on the verge of falling apart.
Lastly, it was the markings on the face. They were gradually worn flat over the long years, becoming no longer visible.
It broke countless times and underwent endless repairs. Its former shape was no longer discernible, and only the stilled sharp hands were pointing ever forward.

Take it, Legwork. It's yours now... Then, continue onward...

The Returning Trail.desc: Traces from a past journey. Accumulate this to progress on the Path of Return.
The Returning Trail.lore: Tracks left behind by the Nameless. Follow its guidance to find your way back to Trailblaze's star rail.

Cosmic Fragment.desc: A unique currency obtained through exploring Simulated Universe. Will be cleared after Simulated Universe is restarted.
Cosmic Fragment.lore:
File fragments generated when the Simulated Universe is running. When they pile up, the performance of Simulated Universe will be significantly affected.

"Sort them regularly. In return, the admin can perhaps change your stats every now and then."

Ability Point.desc: Indescribable materials used to unlock abilities in the Simulated Universe.
Ability Point.lore:
A number you can accumulate or spend to strengthen Support systems in the Simulated Universe.

"It even took Screwllum two system hours to develop an anti-cheat module."

Immersifier.desc: This item can be exchanged by spending 40 Trailblaze Power, and is used to exchange for Immersion Rewards in the Simulated Universe
Immersifier.lore:
This digitized Trailblaze Power can only be used in the Simulated Universe.

"Explore, understand, establish, and connect — that is what it means to trailblaze. Akivili may have fallen, but THEIR legacy continues!"

Deep Immersifier.desc: Quickly extract Planar Ornament in the Interastral Peace Guide
Deep Immersifier.lore:
A deeply digitized form of Trailblaze Power. For use only within the Interastral Peace Guide.

"Trailblazing is not simply a matter of charting the unknown. Akivili had a profound understanding and acceptance of other civilizations, a spirit that lives on among the Nameless."

Achievement Points.desc: Every step of your journey leads to something bigger.
Achievement Points.lore: "The definition of success is broader than conquering a formidable foe or touching the stars. Success is every time you achieve something you've never done before."

The Nameless EXP.desc: Used to increase Nameless Honor levels.
The Nameless EXP.lore:
Accept the gifts of those who came before and begin your own trailblazing expedition.

"Experience often comes at a cost, but that is why they are irreplaceable."

Development Fund.desc: The museum development fund issued by the Architects.
Development Fund.lore: As the museum continues to revitalize and improve, the Architects will issue a development budget for upgrading and recruiting staff, so that {NICKNAME} can better manage the various exhibit halls.

come_from: Obtained from the Fashion Item store
Trendible Voucher.desc: A voucher exclusive to the Astral Imagea Park. Can be used to redeem and open an Imagea mystery box at the Astral Trendibles.
Trendible Voucher.lore: In the Imagea Park, nothing gets your heart racing quite like clutching a gift voucher and making your way to the mystery box shop. What wonderful encounters await this time?

Trendible Token.desc: A token exclusive to the Astral Imagea Park. Can be used to redeem Trendible Vouchers.
Trendible Token.lore: A weighty, one-of-a-kind token stamped with an adorable cat design, brimming with hopes and good fortune.

Star Rail Pass.lore:
Astral Express Universal Pass. Travel as far as the Star Rail stretches.

"Map worlds, meet people, make memories."

Star Rail Special Pass.lore:
Direct ticket for the Astral Express with coordinates of specific worlds, suitable for passengers who just want to go from point A to point B.

"Need to catch up with an old friend? Hop on and see the universe with him/her/it/THEM!"

Fuel Vouchers.desc: Use with Trailblaze Power to quickly obtain materials from Calyxes / Stagnant Shadows
Fuel Vouchers.lore:
To this day, humanity still cannot fully grasp the exact principles behind the Astral Express' traversal of the cosmos. However, as the ancient theory of water boiling tells us, the more fuel in the boiler, the faster the Express goes.

"Boiling water is humanity's most advanced technology, so don't worry too much. Just keep burning stuff."

Fuel.desc: Item used to replenish Trailblaze Power. Provides 60 Trailblaze Power.
Fuel.lore:
Fuel canisters filled up with the dreams and courage of the Nameless.

"Idealism? I prefer to call it the observer effect and human self-actualization."

Travel Encounters.desc: Experience material for characters. Provides 1000 Character EXP.
Travel Encounters.lore:
A travel diary with messy handwriting and random content. It's not of much use to you.

"Dan Heng, hurry up and finish reading it so you can throw it away."

Adventure Log.desc: Experience material for characters. Provides 5000 Character EXP.
Adventure Log.lore:
A neatly organized collection of educational adventure notes containing countless illustrations and texts entailing adventures from beginning to end, as well as valuable information and survival-related techniques.

"Why not just digitize it and save it on a photolith disk? That'd be much more convenient."
"Advanced technology is far more fragile than you'd think when faced with stellar storms and neuron flow eruptions. Besides, I'm sure the author of this book wanted people to read it in the simplest of ways."

Traveler's Guide.desc: Experience material for characters. Provides 20,000 Character EXP.
Traveler's Guide.lore:
Required reading for world exploration. Press the "Read" button to tune in to an attractive voice in a language you understand, telling you about the legendary encounters of renowned adventurers across different worlds as well as the precious wisdom and knowledge that they have gathered.

"All-new series of the Traveler's Guide, The Chef's Manual to Galactic Cuisine, is now available for purchase."
"For submissions, please connect to synesthesia beacon ERD-23θ to contact an Intelligentsia Guild representative. Method of payment can be arranged to your convenience."

Sparse Aether.desc: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides 500 Light Cone EXP.
Sparse Aether.lore:
An imaginary substance that shouldn't exist in reality. The basic material to create Light Cones.
The images contained in the Light Cones become clearer when infused with this substance.

"I see, so this is the supposed 'memoria' of the Garden of Recollection. No wonder the Memokeepers can set off on galactic voyages with memories."

Condensed Aether.desc: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides 2000 Light Cone EXP.
Condensed Aether.lore:
A can of Aether refined through special techniques.

"Handle with care, do not drop or place pressure upon it. If damages and leaks occur, please refer to chapter II of the Leak Disaster Response Manual for emergency response."

Refined Aether.desc: Enhancement material for Light Cones, provides 6000 Light Cone EXP.
Refined Aether.lore:
A canister of aether that has been extracted and distilled using special procedures.

"The Garden looks forward to recreating a past glory, but it is a 'past glory' selected by them. Do you understand?"

Lost Lightdust.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 100 Relic EXP.
Lost Lightdust.lore:
Lightdust permeated the Fragmentum, carrying what seems to indicate the existence of another civilization.

"Theosophy holds that the database used to store information of the material world is called the Akasha Records. I don't necessarily support this, but... these dust indeed store information from the past. They are like... seeds? When you water them, they can yield bountiful fruit."

Lost Gold Fragment.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 500 Relic EXP.
Lost Gold Fragment.lore:
Carefully collected Fragmentum dust with irregular shapes. Under the right conditions, they can express specific forms of relics.

When the stars return to the right position... Ha! Just kidding.

Lost Crystal.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 1000 Relic EXP.
Lost Crystal.lore:
A Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.

"This must not be placed together with the ores offered to the Amber Lord. This is a creation of the Stellaron and goes against the will of Preservation."

Lost Essence.desc: Enhancement material for Relics. Provides 2000 Relic EXP.
Lost Essence.lore:
A large Fragmentum dust crystal that had densified after being reduced to its original form.

"It can even recreate our deceased mother if it has enough information! It really can! Even if it was only for 26 seconds... I just have one question after I completed the experiment: Just why was the Fragmentum created?"

Relic Remains.lore:
Broken parts of a relic that are one step away from decomposing into the Lightdust floating in the Fragmentum.

"Don't take them for mere scraps. I can restore them to their original state."

Self-Modeling Resin.desc: A rare material used for customizing Relics. When synthesizing, you can designate 1 Main Stat from the possible options. With additional consumption, you can further designate 1 to 2 Subsidiary Stats.
Self-Modeling Resin.lore:
This unknown resin is as smooth to the touch as finely-grained dust. It seems to be from the Fragmentum, and has been shaped into the form of a wish by an invisible hand.

"Based on the Guild's research, the Self-Modeling Resin may be the basis of the Fragmentum's capacity to replicate entities..."

Wishful Resin.desc: Matchless materials used to customize Relics. Can be used to specify up to 2 Subsidiary Stats when synthesizing.
Wishful Resin.lore:
An unknown resin that shines like crystals. It seems to have originated from within the Fragmentum. When you draw near, it will resonate strongly with the wishes within your heart.

"It tried to use the Fragmentum's duplicative ability to satisfy human desires, but alas, the gulf is insatiable."

Variable Dice.desc: Use to re-assign the upgrade counts for Subsidiary Stats of fully-enhanced 5-star Relics and randomize their values.
Variable Dice.lore:
A die formed from probability spins alone in the void. The bundled uncertainty ignites and goes out like the birth and death of stars. The universe is filled with variables. If even stars have a chance at resurrection, then what say a Relic?

"Attention: Hazardous variable. Be mindful when you roll the die. If you are not careful, a treasure could turn to trash."

Interference Key.desc: When using Variable Dice to reassign Subsidiary Stats of a 5-star Relic, you can select one Subsidiary Stat to block, preventing it from being enhanced during this reroll.
Interference Key.lore:
The integrated circuits within the encryption key are operating at full capacity, emitting interference factors that intercept countless light rays and correct their trajectories. In the information light screen occupying the entire sky dome, a small dark zone appears: a place even destiny must avoid.

"A discordant note emerges in the rapids of probability, refusing to go with the flow, driving itself like a nail into the marrow of destiny."

Tracks of Destiny.lore: Your victory is secured by countless failures, and the small steps you have taken led you to the turning point of fate.

Undying Embers.lore:
Sighing embers formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.

"At least they were once hot and bright."

Undying Starlight.lore:
Splendid gems formed when a shooting star fell from the sky.

"Precious things stay precious."

Lucent Afterglow.desc: Used to exchange for rewards at the Light Cone Manifest shop.
Lucent Afterglow.lore:
An afterimage of bygone days, invaluable to the Garden of Recollection.

The Garden of Recollection has its own rules: Exchange time for time and memory for memory. The Garden of Recollection can even bring back to you a lost, irrevocable past for the right cost...

Jade Feather.desc: Used to exchange for rewards at the Jokes Come True shop.
Jade Feather.lore:
In 2104 AE, Fomenko — a Candelagraphos scribe — obtained a mute parrot. She took great care of it, but it still only lived for less than a decade. To commemorate her mute friend, Fomenko made quills out of the ten outermost feathers of the parrot's wings. One of these was for herself, while the other nine were stored in a vault.
She used this one quill to annotate for an entire Amber Era, preserving vast swathes of ancient documents on the verge of being lost. At her funeral, her peers and students burst into tears because "a lamp that illuminated our cosmic past had been snuffed out."
It wasn't until people went over Fomenko's legacy that they finally realized that the scribe had been writing nothing but lies with her quills.

"Since the beginning of human history, the birds have been observing all the glory, folly, and glorious and foolish things humans have accomplished. The birds know. The birds take part. The birds remain silent."

come_from: Available at the Jokes Come True store
Lone Stardust.desc: Rewards can be redeemed at the Gift of Stardust Store
Lone Stardust.lore:
The peculiar planet of Convergence-λ possesses an elusive orbit, and its residents occasionally stare into the void, performing acts without logic. The IPC sent people to investigate, but their efforts were always met with one absurd reply: "Because I did it." The Intelligentsia Guild finally detected the influence of the Path of Equilibrium within the world's Crystallite, leading them to pose the crucial question:
"Where is your 'I'?"
"Here, and there."
They gestured to themselves, and to the nonexistent barycenter beyond their world, reaching out into the distant void...
"...They could never walk into the annihilating embrace of a binary star system, for they were never truly able to hold one another."

Superimposer (Custom-made).desc: A special gadget made by Herta. It can Superimpose special Light Cones obtained from the Simulated Universe.
Superimposer (Custom-made).lore:
A special gadget made by Herta. Its principles are not stated.

"Be grateful, {NICKNAME}. I've prepared everything for you."

come_from: Redeemable after obtaining a duplicate of a 5-star character with maxed Eidolons twice
Redeemable after obtaining a duplicate of a 5-star character with maxed Eidolons twice
Golden Companion Spirit.desc: Used to exchange for a 5-star character at the Stellar Convergence shop.
Golden Companion Spirit.lore: "Even the tiniest speck of dust, drawn by the call of exploration, can gather into a dazzling golden nova."

come_from: Redeemable after obtaining a duplicate of a 5-star character with maxed Eidolons
Silver Companion Spirit.desc: Used to exchange for Golden Companion Spirits at the Stellar Convergence shop.
Silver Companion Spirit.lore: "Even the tiniest speck of dust, drawn by the call of exploration, can gather into a dazzling silver nova."

Light Cone Memory Shard.desc: Used to exchange for a 5-star Light Cone at the Stellar Convergence shop.
Light Cone Memory Shard.lore: "Perhaps I'll be able to piece together the fragmented memories once I catch up to that light."

Wishing Stardust.desc: Obtained through Astral Imagea reclamation. Collect a certain amount to exchange for Trendible Vouchers at the Cosmetics Store.
Wishing Stardust.lore: The IPC's latest research findings, cleverly woven into the creation of collectible figures, mystery boxes, and other products, giving each toy a delightful personality of its own. The results speak for themselves as every new release flies off the shelves.

Heromorpher Wish.lore:
In Planarcadia, where wishes can become strength, your desire to "hold the light high and become a hero" has answered your call, taking physical form to inspire your journey onward. Accept it for now, sooner or later, it will become your one-of-a-kind help.

"According to highly unreliable statistics, everyone in Planarcadia has dreamed of transforming into a superhero at some point."

Herta Bond.desc: A reward from the Simulated Universe. Can be used to buy items from Herta's Store.

First Voyage's Blessing.desc: Use to gain 60 Trailblaze Power and a 1:1 replica.
First Voyage's Blessing.lore:
A blessing offered to those starting their journey.

May you embrace the skies and give the greetings of your first voyage to the endless starry seas.
May you cross the snowstorm and ignite an eternal flame at the end of the frigid winter.
The footsteps you leave behind will one day become a road upon which stars would shine.

Wayfare's Blessing.lore:
A blessing offered to wayfarers on the journey.

May you navigate through the delves and behold how fathomless wakespans paint the scintillating beauty of life.
May you explore the Sea of Dreams and play a rousing melody for the enchanting land of fantasia.
Your traces there will condense into the memories that overflow the very river of stars.

Golden Blessing.lore:
A blessing bestowed upon those who embark on the Flame-Chase Journey.

May you dance with the gods, reigniting the fallen giant with the fire of heroes.
May you overthrow fate, illuminating the world and all living beings with the light of dawn.
Your journey here will forever be etched into the ancient ballads of legend.

Phantasia's Blessing.lore:
A Blessing for the Protagonist

May you strike down injustice, unafraid to shatter false Masks with your true self.
May you carry the hopes of all, raise the sail of trailblazing under a thousand stars.
Your Traces in this realm shall echo across the cosmos as the joy of the arcadia.

As Tomorrow Became Yesterday.lore:
{NICKNAME}:

Hey, I miss you. Maybe this feels a bit out of the blue, but I just wanna take a look back one last time.

The journey of Trailblaze must be filled with unknowns. So, I thought... why not leave you one more surprise? A ripple of memories, along with a touch of fairy magic.

Before we knew it, we've shared such a long walk together. I wonder what story you'll write at the next stop on your journey. I will be in your memories, longing... Whenever I close my eyes, I can see yours, carrying the whole universe...

Like waves of wheat rustling in the breeze, or the tomorrow where stars shine ♪

Cyrene

come_from: Obtained from Saga of Primaveral Blade
Obtained in the Luminary Wardance event
Obtained by upgrading the Clockie Statue

Relic Coffret: Passerby of Wandering Clo.desc: A device used to collect and restore the Lightdust in the Fragmentum to its original form. Use this to obtain a random 5-star relic from the Passerby of Wandering Cloud set.
Relic Coffret: Passerby of Wandering Clo.lore:
You never know what's in the box until you open it.

"So it's essentially like buying a lottery ticket?"
"At least we don't need to worry about finding a cat that is both dead and alive."
