Star of Honor.desc: Virtual goods from Cosmic Warfare. Collect enough of them to receive rewards.

Tears of Dreams.desc: Sealed thoughts and feelings. Can substitute Path Materials when they are insufficient. The substitution ratio of Tears of Dreams varies depending on the materials' rarity.
Tears of Dreams.lore:
The unresolved resentment, the unsolved puzzle, the places never reached, the achievements never attained... All the regrets that make the human soul bend its knees are sealed into these tears condensed by time. 

"Believe me, everything is possible in dreams..."

Shattered Blade.desc: Weapon fragments left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces slightly for Destruction characters.
Shattered Blade.lore:
This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction.
The master of this weapon rides on a scarlet horse to ignite cities, to take peace from humankind, and to bring down nations akin to anthills.

"The bearer of this brand is tasked with driving peace out of nations."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword
On the Fall of an Aeon

Lifeless Blade.desc: Weapon remnants left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces moderately for Destruction characters.
Lifeless Blade.lore:
This brand represents their rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction.
The master of this weapon carries a strong hatred for all sentient beings. They relish in the lament of intelligent beings as sweet melodies and topple civilizations with millennia of history in the blink of an eye.

"The bearer of this brand is tasked with stopping breath among the living."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword
On the Fall of an Aeon

Worldbreaker Blade.desc: Broken weapon left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces significantly for Destruction characters.
Worldbreaker Blade.lore:
This weapon represents its owner's rank and accomplishments in the name of Destruction.
The owner of this weapon makes their appearance at the end of a war to fan the embers to consume the world. Regardless of the glories of the past or the blessing of its deities, this planet is destined to return to the ashes it came from, and to wither away in the depths of the starry sky.

"The bearer of this brand is tasked with purifying the world."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword
On the Fall of an Aeon

Arrow of the Beast Hunter.desc: An arrowhead forged with Frost Steel by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces slightly for Hunt characters.
Arrow of the Beast Hunter.lore:
A gift that parents give to their children who've successfully hunted their first prey at their coming of age ceremony. It is a blessing that their life would be as successful and true as an arrow heading towards its mark.

"May the arrow on your waist and the sword in your sheath stay true and always find its target."

Arrow of the Demon Slayer.desc: An arrowhead forged with Stellaris Essence by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces moderately for Hunt characters.
Arrow of the Demon Slayer.lore:
An arrow narrower than a finger's width. It can be loaded into an electromagnetic crossbow or a thermal seeking bow as ammunition. Its power is enough to penetrate the tough shells of abominations with just one strike.

"The celestial banished arrives from afar, great distances journeyed 'twixt oceans of stars. Like rain falls a cloudburst of arrows below, in a helmet reflected the bright lunar glow."

Arrow of the Starchaser.desc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for Hunt characters.
Arrow of the Starchaser.lore:
The remains of a divine construct that ordinary humans can rarely behold. What kind of force can shatter stars that are light-years away? Humanity can only imagine the power of the Lux Arrow from the ashes it left behind.
Only the Furnace Master, chief of the Xianzhou artisans, has the rights to reforge the shards for those who are worthy.

"The death of a star shall shine bright for ages to come."

Key of Inspiration.desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the Meditative Scholars. Used to level up Traces slightly for Erudition characters.
Key of Inspiration.lore:
It can unlock inspirations hidden deep within the conscience.
To take hold of the key is to grasp at the darting embers of thought that lead to the forward path.

"Eureka!"

Key of Knowledge.desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for Erudition characters.
Key of Knowledge.lore:
It can unlock the mysteries binding the truth of the world and grants knowledge beyond the understanding of humans.
No matter how the wielder attempts to display their possession of the key, no one but themselves can see its form. Some people believe that to be a gift from the heavens, while others think it's a sign of mental disorder.

"I had a dream of molecules coiling up into a loop like a snake biting its own tail. I woke up realizing that this is the answer I've been looking for all along!"

Key of Wisdom.desc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for Erudition characters.
Key of Wisdom.lore:
This is the proof of invitation to the halls of the Nous Temple.
Finding the door of which this key opens is a far more arduous task than obtaining the key itself. Those who pass through the doors will immediately realize the impossibility of returning to this side.

"The Erudition does not have answers to the universe, but it will teach you how to ask the right questions."

Endurance of Bronze.desc: A crude but durable ancient hand-held bronze shield. Used to level up Traces slightly for Preservation characters.
Endurance of Bronze.lore:
Ancient legends entail a war where humans exhausted all primitive methods, following the gods into battle against overwhelmingly powerful beasts.
This shield is a witness to that war.

"There's no choice but to stop it, even if the efforts are futile."

light_cones: Day One of My New Life

Oath of Steel.desc: A shield forged with irreplaceable craftsmanship from an unknown alloy. Used to level up Traces moderately for Preservation characters.
Oath of Steel.lore:
It may be a large shield, but it feels as light as a feather. Even after taking on a full charge, no marks can be seen on the face of the shield.
Ancient legends tell of a war where high-spirited warriors wielded deathray-beaming spears and shields forged of Frost Steel, defended a nation destined to falter in the face of war.
This shield is a witness to that war.

"Powerful voices chant: 'The enemies are at our gates!'"

light_cones: Day One of My New Life

Safeguard of Amber.desc: An unusual shield embedded with ambers mined from beyond the skies. Used to level up Traces significantly for Preservation characters.
Safeguard of Amber.lore:
The wielder of this shield is seemingly protected by an invisible shield wall, immune to fiery arrows or mountainous claws.
Ancient legends entail a war where a tribal hero wielding a bronze shield charged to their death against a leviathan, together with warriors armed with fiery spears.
This shield is a witness to that war.

"Do not cross the line."

light_cones: Day One of My New Life

Obsidian of Dread.desc: A fragment of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces slightly for Nihility characters.
Obsidian of Dread.lore:
Nothing can prove its noumenon.
Touch gently to hear an unclear murmur from the shard.

"████ ██ █ █"

light_cones: In the Name of the World
Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

Obsidian of Desolation.desc: A chunk of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces moderately for Nihility characters.
Obsidian of Desolation.lore:
No reflections can be seen on the surface of the black prism. Not only does it suck in all the light, it seems to also absorb the wielder's emotions, leaving only a faint feeling of emptiness.

"..."

light_cones: In the Name of the World
Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

Obsidian of Obsession.desc: A sizable piece of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces significantly for Nihility characters.
Obsidian of Obsession.lore:
The weak-minded and soft-willed will spend their eternity in chaos from just a simple glance into the prism.

"         "

light_cones: In the Name of the World
Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

Harmonic Tune.desc: A compact music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces slightly for Harmony characters.
Harmonic Tune.lore:
It plays a relaxing and joyful tune.
Even through the simplistic tune, anyone with the slightest understanding of music can tell the mastery of the composer of the piece.

"Grab the hands of your Family and let us dance!"

light_cones: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds

Ancestral Hymn.desc: A music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces moderately for Harmony characters.
Ancestral Hymn.lore:
It plays a hymn sung by a small band.
It is impossible to find out to whom the lyric of the hymn sends its praise.

"Penury, trial of the Great One! Wealth, grace of the Great One!"

light_cones: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds

Stellaris Symphony.desc: A music box with complex structures made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces significantly for Harmony characters.
Stellaris Symphony.lore:
It plays a powerful cosmic symphony.

"Some astronomers believe that the revolutions of the heavenly spheres work the same as complex mechanical structures. The crystal clear and pleasant notes emitted during the movements of the stars are known as the 'Harmony of the Heavenly Spheres.'"

light_cones: Carve the Moon, Weave the Clouds

Seed of Abundance.desc: A seed of blessing sown by the Aeon of Abundance. Used to level up Traces slightly for Abundance characters.
Seed of Abundance.lore:
Those who come in contact with it are slowly healed of their wounds and illnesses.
People who pray for the blessing of life while in despair will always have their prayers answered.

"You shall be granted what you ask for."

Sprout of Life.desc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for Abundance characters.
Sprout of Life.lore:
Radiating warmth, life and growth flourish around the place where it sinks its roots. Barren wastelands turn into luscious grass fields, withered plants rejuvenate and blossom, and springs burst through the ground to moisten the land.
As you get closer to it, your muscles and bones twitch and propagate with an unbearable itch.

"Life is unfailing where the soul abounds."

Flower of Eternity.desc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for Abundance characters.
Flower of Eternity.lore:
The stamen contains the concentrated power of the Path of Abundance, ensuring the flower's ever-lasting vitality. No fire, ice, or any harshness can hinder the growth of this magnificent life form.
Given time, its leaves shall feed upon starlight. Its roots shall burrow into the flesh of every being of this world, all-connected, never-perishing. Its fruits shall fulfill the promise of immortality.

"There be giant ships, eclipsing mountains, drifting over the void. Upon them grows the undying tree. Its consumption grants immortality."

Borisin Teeth.desc: Broken teeth fragments left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces slightly for Destruction characters.
Borisin Teeth.lore:
Borisin consider their teeth as a warrior's blade and weapon.
The borisin worship warriors possessing supreme power. In their tribes, where the strong rule the weak, those with dental caries will only be discarded by the group.

"O, Brood Lord, grant us sharp teeth and claws."

light_cones: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path

Lupitoxin Sawteeth.desc: Blood-sucking sharp fangs left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces moderately for Destruction characters.
Lupitoxin Sawteeth.lore:
Borisin consider their teeth as a warrior's blade and weapon.
A maddening impulse flows through the borisin blood. Fueled by Lupitoxin, they rend their enemies with their sawteeth and suck their blood, and are undefeated.

"O, Brood Lord, grant us steel skin and bones."

light_cones: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path

Moon Rage Fang.desc: Terrifying tusks left behind during the borisin conquests. Used to level up Traces significantly for Destruction characters.
Moon Rage Fang.lore:
Borisin can further enhance their bodies through their innate "Moon Rage."
The battle-frenzied warriors exhibit incredible healing abilities, shedding the blood of their enemies in a sanguine mist together with the unbridled growth of their muscles and bones.

"O, Brood Lord, grant us divine strength."

light_cones: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path

Meteoric Bullet.desc: Iron pellets forged for hunting monsters. Each one bears scratches that seem to record the number of prey that perished because of it. Used to level up Traces slightly for The Hunt characters.
Meteoric Bullet.lore:
The Armed Archaeologists discovered these iron pellets among various types of monster fossils and bones. Radioactive dating confirmed that they were fired in an era when humanity did not yet exist, and the creatures they shot were the last remnants of a certain monster species.

"Death by old age is no different from death by bullet. The way of the hunter won't lead to a sacred nor sinful end."

Destined Expiration.desc: Embedded in the deceased's brow, piercing through the crevice of matter, this bullet forever resides where its bullet hole should be. Used to level up Traces moderately for The Hunt characters.
Destined Expiration.lore:
It traversed the winding paths amidst legions of soldiers, pierced through the weakest point of the stoutest helmets, and finally came to rest at the center of the skull of the invincible tyrant, emitting a whisper-like sigh. Its arrival came like a fatal coincidence. Its arrival was akin to an endpoint that all were fated to meet.

"Sometimes, the bullet hole precedes the trajectory."

Countertemporal Shot.desc: A spiral bullet forever going against the arrow of time, like a hound eternally chasing the immortal that defies time. Used to level up Traces significantly for The Hunt characters.
Countertemporal Shot.lore:
Once the embers of a Lord Ravager, the button to erase a civilization, and the final lament of an ancient behemoth... How many deaths must these materials have gathered to forge such ammunition? And what kind of firearm can propel it into the past? It is the answer to all. It is not a question itself.

"Run. Flee to any moment's interstice. It will always find you, nailing you down in the fabric of fate."

Rough Sketch.desc: The character design draft for Clockie, where a few pen strokes already gave the dream a shape. Used to level up Traces slightly for Erudition characters.
Rough Sketch.lore:
Various original sketches of Clockie are widely circulated on Penacony. Exactly who captured the fleeting spark of inspiration and rang the first sound of "tick-tock" on the canvas?

"Tick-tock! You... can see me?"

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

Dynamic Outlining.desc: A Clockie outline drawing, where the silhouette of the dream was already leaping out of the page. Used to level up Traces moderately for Erudition characters.
Dynamic Outlining.lore:
The Clockie drawing looks more refined after the unnecessary strokes are removed. The animators hid their wisdom in every frame of Clockie's dance and can be clearly discerned.

"Tick-tock, tick-tock! Keep up, my friend!"

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

Exquisite Colored Draft.desc: A colored draft of Clockie that brings the dream to life with vibrant colors. Used to level up Traces significantly for Erudition characters.
Exquisite Colored Draft.lore:
Clockie becomes filled with colors, taking on the shape that will become a household name. Clockie's story inspired millions of Dreamchasers, with every one of them able to be inspired by his fantastical adventures.

"My name is Clockie, and I'm a superstar in Dreamville Penacony!"

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

Scattered Stardust.desc: The dust that falls from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the divine hammer. Used to level up Traces slightly for Preservation characters.
Scattered Stardust.lore:
The guards at Pier Point have never left their posts on Qlipoth's orbit, simply waiting for a miracle that only occurs once in decades or even centuries — How stardust splutters up like countless raindrops the moment the giant hammer falls.

"The stardust are simply insignificant dust to the Amber Lord, but to us, every speck of it contains the essence of Preservation."

Crystal Meteorites.desc: The crystals that separate from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the celestial hammer. Used to level up Traces moderately for Preservation characters.
Crystal Meteorites.lore:
People only become aware of the fact that Qlipoth has swung THEIR hammer again from the two phenomena invariably detected afterward: An enormous burst of intense gravitational waves, and "starquakes." Like a gift from the Preservation, the crystal meteorites dash across the dark sky and announce the beginning of a new Era.

"The Genius Society is audacious enough to declare the Amber Lord as the slowest Aeon in the Cosmos, but none of these people have ever successfully observed the entire process of Qlipoth swinging the celestial hammer."

Divine Amber.desc: The amber that rains from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the celestial hammer. Used to level up Traces significantly for Preservation characters.
Divine Amber.lore:
Although Pier Point sent out Meteor Hunters and intercepted most of the meteors, the brightest one among all these shooting stars will always only be seen by the chosen one.

"It is a part of the divine body of the Aeon, albeit an insignificant one. Only the chosen ones, with their minds as steadfast as cornerstones and having endured challenges and hardships, can chisel apart this amber and unleash the crystalized light within."

Fiery Spirit.desc: Feeble heliobus that scattered after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces slightly for Nihility characters.
Fiery Spirit.lore:
An innocent, formless heliobus.
The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. This little heliobus is innocent and naive and may be easily consumed by more powerful heliobi.

"Formless, rootless, and roaming boundless..."

Starfire Essence.desc: A mature heliobus that ran away after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces moderately for Nihility characters.
Starfire Essence.lore:
A mean and nasty heliobus that appears like a full flame.
The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. This torch-like heliobus has just tasted consciousness and is eager to devour its host's emotions and desires.

"Absorb their emotions and sway their wills..."

Heaven Incinerator.desc: A beast-form heliobus that homogenized after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces significantly for Nihility characters.
Heaven Incinerator.lore:
An intelligent and powerful heliobus that has started to take the form of a beast.
The size of a heliobus's flame when it materializes indicates its strength. A large heliobus, having homogenized its numerous lesser peers, will gradually have a stable shape. These immortal beings can become so dangerous that they are considered calamities.

"Floods, fires, landslides, and thunderstorms..."

Firmament Note.desc: Scattered note from the firmament. Used to level up Traces slightly for Harmony characters.
Firmament Note.lore:
A musical note scattered from order. Falling silently from the edge of the clouds, it blends into the symphony of mortal sounds, like a tear dissolving into the sea.

"No one hears it until it dissolves into a song..."

Celestial Section.desc: Melodious section fallen from the heavens. Used to level up Traces moderately for Harmony characters.
Celestial Section.lore:
A musical section scattered from order. Falling silently from the edge of the heavens, it blends into the cacophony, like grains of sand scattered in the desert.

"No one notices it until it ignites a spark of inspiration..."

Heavenly Melody.desc: Symphonic movements from the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for Harmony characters.
Heavenly Melody.lore:
A piece of music scattered from order. It quietly echoes from beyond the heavens, drowned out by profound silence, like a lone star twinkling in a river of stars.

"No one feels it until it is forgotten by all ♬..."

Alien Tree Seed.desc: The seed obtained from the fruit of the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest, carrying the genes of various life forms. Used to level up Traces slightly for Abundance characters.
Alien Tree Seed.lore:
The enormous alien holy tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest meticulously records the changes of the ecosystem over countless life cycles, continuously nurturing the ideal "Devil" using the genes of various life forms as seeds.

"Cut this hard fruit open, scoop out the seed from its flesh, and plant it in sacred soil. You'll harvest dozens of leaders in the following year. Just wait for them to decide a winner via a battle royale!"

Nourishing Honey.desc: The nectar brewed from the juice of flowers growing on the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest. A honey that can accelerate the growth of life. Used to level up Traces moderately for Abundance characters.
Nourishing Honey.lore:
When the Devil emerges from the fertile soil, it is only a round fruit with a stalk as long as a human's forearm. For some reason, it has to defeat its siblings before it has the right to drink nectar and grow into shape.

"You can drink the sap of any tree in this forest, except that one."

Myriad Fruit.desc: The fruit grown on the tip of the heart tree's branch in the sacred Vonwacq forest. It contains the essence of myriad lifeforms. Used to level up Traces significantly for Abundance characters.
Myriad Fruit.lore:
One day and night after drinking the nectar of the divine tree, the ridiculous spherical fruit bloats into a "Devil" wearing fiber armor and wielding a wooden spear and a shield made of leaves. All around its footsteps, living creatures in the forest offer their genes as tributes to the Devil for it to taste, learn, and metamorphose. After that, the Devil will move on to challenge the sea and the sky of Vonwacq.

"Through this method, the ancient sages imprisoned the most terrifying thing within a most ridiculous game."

Bīja of Consciousness.desc: Consciousness fuses with matter, giving rise to the embryo of memory. Used to level up Traces slightly for Remembrance characters.
Bīja of Consciousness.lore:
This thing does not truly exist until you see, hear, or sense something. This existence born from sensations soon falls silent, buried in the soil of thought — it may sprout one day, or it may not.

"Such is the substance that forms our bodies, existing because you remember."

light_cones: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

Seedling of Manas.desc: Memory's cells extract thoughts, propagating in the heart of the inscriber. Used to level up Traces moderately for Remembrance characters.
Seedling of Manas.lore:
The seeds take root and sprout. Branches and buds weave together, transmitting signals like a living network of synapses. Over the passage of years, some wither and fade, while others flourish, growing strong enough to bear life and form the vessel of a soul. 

"We did not abandon the flesh. We merely transformed it into something... more enduring."

light_cones: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

Flower of Ālaya.desc: This is another form for life to exist and a substance that the universe cannot forget. Used to level up Traces significantly for Remembrance characters.
Flower of Ālaya.lore:
It matures. It becomes a web that constrains history, a blossom from the past. Life is its flower bed or its pistil. If you become the pistil, then you remember the universe and the universe remembers you. You are memory. 

"Memory is the true form of all things, thus there is no creation or annihilation in the Anāśrava pure land."

light_cones: Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

The Fluffy Hand-drawn Storyboards.desc: Fluffy Across the Blue in its storyboard stage. Slightly increases the Traces of Elation characters.
The Fluffy Hand-drawn Storyboards.lore:
Blurry is an incredibly fast artist who can draw a month's worth of work in a single day. But they never do, claiming they need to "guarantee quality," though they're likely just allergic to work.

"It's so weird... how are there so many identical manuscripts of 'The Fluffy' out there, and every single one is clearly an original? Is Blurry selling these to make a quick buck?"
"No way! Blurry is just a perfectionist who draws every page ten times until it's exactly right."

The Fluffy Serialization Memorial Issue.desc: Fluffy Across the Blue currently in magazine serialization. Moderately increases the Traces of Elation characters.
The Fluffy Serialization Memorial Issue.lore:
Rumor has it that a Phantasmoon Games winner once accelerated time, leaving every artist in Planarcadia unable to meet their deadlines, except for Blurry. This is clearly just a tabloid story, and knowing them, QR_Colt probably wrote it themselves.

"I was born drawing as well as Graphia, but it took me an entire lifetime to learn how to draw as fast as a Bullet Wyrm." — QR_Colt, during an online interview

The Fluffy Collector's Edition.desc: Fluffy Across the Blue, now in published standalone volumes. Greatly increases the Traces of Elation characters.
The Fluffy Collector's Edition.lore:
The book's wrap-around band is packed with glowing reviews from cosmic icons like Pearl, Jade, Aventurine, Topaz, Ratio, Jing Yuan, Feixiao, Huaiyan, Yao Guang, Hua, Kafka, Robin, Arita, Schneider, Duke Inferno, Hoolay, Ryusuke, Sparkle, Sparxie, and {NICKNAME}. Blurry eventually lost a fortune in lawsuits for "forging endorsements and false advertising."

"Counselor Umbralle, these petty celebrities are all ganging up to sue me. Can I hire you as my defense?"
"Hahaha, you're funny. But I'd quite like to stay alive, thank you."

Grit of Strife.desc: Crimson crystal dust that Castrum Kremnos craftsmen use to coat their weapons. Slightly increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.
Grit of Strife.lore:
Dried divine blood that has crumbled into drifting crimson dust. It is the most primal, pervasive form of power, carrying the blessing and protection of Nikador.

"Go on, keep talking! Once I arrive, it's the only thing you'll be able to do."

Resin of Valor.desc: Crimson crystal amber forged by the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos while tempering weapons. Moderately increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.
Resin of Valor.lore:
Shimmering crimson crystals forged by melting divine blood dust in the fires of strife. These amber-like shards pulse with the rage and punishment of Nikador.

"Let your arrows fly! They are but a refreshing rain to soothe the scorching heat of war."

Lance of Retribution.desc: A crimson spear forged from the lives and dignity of the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos. Greatly increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.
Lance of Retribution.lore:
A spear forged by infusing blood-amber with a warrior's oath and the glory of victory. As the manifestation of the Lance of Fury, it embodies the very laws and essence of Nikador.

"Show me your valiance! I shall still pay my respects... with steel and with blood."

Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check.desc: A four-sided die used for simple checks. Can slightly level up Traces for Destruction characters.
Four Phases, Crossing the River to Check.lore:
The benefit of a four-sided die is that, if you believe in it, it will make every problem easy.
Complex dilemmas, unsolvable games, and all those situations you have no idea how to handle — the hard part of it all lies in "not knowing what the optimal solution is." We spend our whole lives with a desire to grasp the power to select, yet spend that same lifetime feeling the anxiety of potential regret.
But a four-sided die doesn't need to think about any of that. There is no optimal solution in the life of a die. In other words, in a die's life, all four sides are the optimal solution.

"So don't overthink it. No matter what you select, I will declare it: a great success."

Sixen, King-Rook Fork.desc: A six-sided die used for complex destiny checks. Can moderately upgrade the Traces of Destruction characters.
Sixen, King-Rook Fork.lore:
Once cast, the result of a six-sided die cannot be defied. This is the prerequisite for its presence at the gambling table, anchoring one's life, death, and destiny.
The thrower "chooses" to cast it, and it brings a "result." But this is not the end, as the cycle of cause and effect has only just begun.
Everyone must be prepared for the consequences of their choices, and even a Lord Ravager is no exception.

"Yeah... I need to request some last-minute annual leave... Just in case the destruction of the world fails, I'll still need to keep my day job, you know."

Omnicolor, Fool's Own.desc: A bizarre, myriad-colored die that binds infinite futures. Can greatly level up Traces for Destruction characters.
Omnicolor, Fool's Own.lore:
Of course, there are also those who "choose" to reroll to escape a destiny of failure. That Lord Ravager is also keen on granting this opportunity.
Unsatisfactory calculations, imperfect endings... He never tires of permitting a do-over. But every time he chooses to take the die back into his hands, its number of faces increases geometrically.

"Friend, life's success rate doesn't go up just because you have more choices."

Celestial Globe.desc: A beginner-level model suitable for astronomy enthusiasts to study. Can slightly level up Traces for Erudition characters.
Celestial Globe.lore:
The model, clutched in youthful hands, was once warmed to a scorching temperature by love and longing.
Despite its simple craftsmanship and ordinary materials, it was enough to make a child believe that the boundless universe was nothing more than a small sphere in their palm.
It depicted a corner of the vast universe for the youth, only to be left behind forever at their childhood bedside.

"Later, I ventured into the cosmos, far from home... Through the windows of the Express, my homeland had indeed become a tiny little thing."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

Galaxy Framework.desc: A framework of a galaxy used for advanced studies in interstellar navigation. Used to moderately level up Traces for Erudition characters.
Galaxy Framework.lore:
In the Interstellar Navigation Dynamics class, the vast sea of stars is measured down to the inch, and eternal stars are reduced to mere framework components with varying specs and parameters.
From then on, the distant horizon is crowded with scores and assessments, and romance must be written out as answers in black and white.
It seems the academic journey demands far more passion than one might expect.

"This galactic framework is beautifully crafted. I mean, I should give you an A."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

Cosmic Sandpit.desc: A cosmic sandpit drawn by a Navigator after surveying the universe. Can greatly level up Traces for Erudition characters.
Cosmic Sandpit.lore:
The picture painted by the pioneers is all-encompassing, and the simulated sandpit is vast enough to embrace the entire sea of stars.
Latecomers take this as the starting point of their journey. Packing the sandpit into their handbags, they follow in the footsteps of their predecessors.
It was not until the stars fell and she looked back that she realized: through all the meetings and partings along the way, she had journeyed ahead of everyone else, stepping among stars unrecorded even by the sandpit.

"The meaning of the universe must lie beyond the universe."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

Tear of Phagousa.desc: A glass-like water droplet. Used to level up Traces slightly for Nihility characters.
Tear of Phagousa.lore:
Look through its clear surface and you will see fish-like shadows drifting within. Yet, they can never swim past the edge of this tear. 

"Drink it, and you'll see your homeland and the shore you can never reach."

Wine of Phagousa.desc: Waves overflowing from the cup. Used to level up Traces moderately for Nihility characters.
Wine of Phagousa.lore:
The tides refract an intense blue, as if properly chronicling this banquet, held once and nevermore.

"When believers shatter their honey brew-filled chalices, ocean waves shall bloom upon the earth."

Heart of Phagousa.desc: A crystal made of countless ocean waves. Used to level up Traces significantly for Nihility characters.
Heart of Phagousa.lore:
It pulses like a beating heart and its gills open like an exhale, for an ocean still lives within it.

"She pressed the ocean into her chest, trading it for eternal silence."

Enigmatic Ectostella.desc: A fathomless crystal. Ascension material for the Trailblazer.
Enigmatic Ectostella.lore:
Severed from the highest of beings, this crystal reflects ever-changing mirages. The past and future intertwine on each of its countless facets, attempting to swallow up all observers.

"Civilization is but a thin sheet of ice on top of the deep dark ocean of chaos."

Broken Teeth of Iron Wolf.desc: Fragmented saw teeth left behind by automatons. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
Broken Teeth of Iron Wolf.lore:
It is said that the smelting techniques of the Architects allowed them to make chainsaws sturdy enough to split giant boulders. Such techniques have been long lost to history.

"Boss Svarog says its blade is so thin that it can cut into the gap between molecules... What are molecules?"

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: Silvermane Guard Restricted Zone
Endotherm Chitin.desc: Hot, translucent substance almost like fire in the solid state. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.
Endotherm Chitin.lore:
Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not piping hot anymore, it still radiates warmth.

"It's too cold outside. But with this gemstone on you, you'll be able to travel far and wide, even to search for cities with humans left..."

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: Corridor of Fading Echoes
Horn of Snow.desc: Broken horn of a Frigid Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
Horn of Snow.lore:
The Silvermane Guards would host contests where the winner must take a body part from a monster and bring it back within a set time limit. This cold broken horn must have been a trophy of one such contest.

"Sir Bova, this is no moose horn and is certainly not fit for decoration above the Geomarrow furnace."

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: Corridor of Fading Echoes
Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow.desc: Headwear of the Guardian Shadows. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow.lore:
Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.

"Svetlana the Iron Fist — her wrath as terrifying as thunder and her retribution as swift as lightning."

Storm Eye.desc: Arrows belonged to a Stormbringer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
Storm Eye.lore:
Used to belong to a certain Fragmentum monster modeled after a certain kind of Voidrangers. An arrowhead can be barely seen buried in the center of the vortex.

"Those who perish in the Fragmentum shall rise again where they met their demise."

Void Cast Iron.desc: Horseshoe of a Voidranger: Trampler. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
Void Cast Iron.lore:
Rare horseshoe obtained when a Trampler of the Antimatter Legion is defeated. When no one is observing, it pops in and out of existence.

"The name of the experiment? It's just called "Horseshoe of the Trampler"... "

Golden Crown of the Past Shadow.desc: Headwear of the Decaying Shadow. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
Golden Crown of the Past Shadow.lore:
Accessory left behind by the shadow of a past Guardian, telling tales of the city of Everwinter.

"Alina the Loving — her kindness as lofty as the sky and her compassion as brilliant as gold."

Netherworld Token.desc: The Aurumaton Spectral Envoy's weapon. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
Netherworld Token.lore:
This is both a weapon used by the Ten-Lords Commission messengers to subdue mara and abominations, as well as a token they present when undertaking operations. No authorities of the mortal realm have jurisdiction over them.

"Messengers of Netherworld, authorized envoys of death's realm. Bearing orders for apprehension, with no pardon for transgressors."

Searing Steel Blade.desc: The broken blade of a Searing Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire-Type characters.
Searing Steel Blade.lore:
The Silvermane Guards would host contests where the winner must take a body part from a monster and bring it back within a set time limit. This broken blade must have been a trophy of one such contest.

"I saw it with my own eyes. Captain Gepard smashed that thing's hot steel blade with one blow of his fist, then held it with his bare hands and plunged it into the belly of that cold fatty, warming its heart."

Gelid Chitin.desc: Frosty chitin emitting a cold humming. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
Gelid Chitin.lore:
Strange chitin peeled off from an interdimensional creature. Although not freezing cold anymore, it remains trembling, absorbing heat from its surroundings.

"How has no one thought of selling it to worlds where they don't have air conditioners? It works like an air conditioner and sounds as loud as one, too."

Shape Shifter's Lightning Staff.desc: A wooden staff with a pointed tip. It belonged to a shape shifter from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
Shape Shifter's Lightning Staff.lore:
According to ancient Xianzhou records, those who have ascended can summon lightning and command the wind. The Disciples of Sanctus Medicus claimed to have inherited the way of the gods. By demonstrating godly power, the disciples gathered large numbers of worshipers in secret. Branches of lightning coil around this wooden staff — could it be that the disciples were indeed no mere mortals?

"The mortal body is but an illusion. Truth is only revealed to those who choose to ascend."

Ascendant Debris.desc: Remains of The Ascended. Can be used for Ascension of Wind characters.
Ascendant Debris.lore:
The Ascended originally intended to bring the world a legacy of kindness, but as the bestowment of Abundance fades, understanding arrives alongside liberation: They were nothing more than a mortal with flesh and blood. Their ability to traverse the skies was nothing but an illusion, and all that remained of their existence was dust and dirt.

"I curse ye, Reignbow Arbiter..."

Nail of the Ape.desc: Remnant of an Abundance Sprite. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
Nail of the Ape.lore:
The distinction between "sprite" and "abomination" is merely a matter of name. A sprite is tamed and obedient, while an abomination is an uncontrolled misfortune. This nail embedded in the body of the Malefic Ape serves as an eternal guarantee of its status as a sprite.

"As a disciple, it is your duty to obey. If the Master Primus drives this Possession Nail into your body, then you will have no choice but to obey, won't you?"

Suppressing Edict.desc: Parts used in the Xianzhou ingenium technology. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
Suppressing Edict.lore:
After Rubert unleashed the calamity of inorganic life, the aurumaton in Xianzhou also rebelled and began a ruthless slaughter. To ensure that the turmoil does not resurface, the craftsmen imposed imprisonment using talismans, stripping the aurumaton of their ability to think.

"What on earth did you do to make this fellow go mad?"
"I didn't do anything! I just... cleaned that golden talisman a bit."

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: Clock Studios Theme Park
IPC Work Permit.desc: An IPC "Senior Staff" work permit. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
IPC Work Permit.lore:
In the IPC, only project team leaders will have a work permit in this style. For workaholics like these experienced staff, they'd sooner forget to wear clothes than this name card.

"This is more than just a pass into Pier Point. It is a status symbol!"

Raging Heart.desc: The memoria core of "Shell of Faded Rage." Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.
Raging Heart.lore:
The flames of anger will eventually consume themselves, erasing the original cause of the rage, and leaving behind only lingering resentment and an unquenchable core of poisonous hatred.

"The memoria of fury will persist due to the hatred, yet it will also become unrealistic due to that hatred."

Dream Fridge.desc: The fridge carried by Sweet Gorilla. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
Dream Fridge.lore:
A special SoulGlad fridge designed to preserve icy sweetness.
It serves as a tool for transporting drinks for the Sweet Dreams Troupe, and can also be wielded as a weapon when they are transformed into the Dreamjolt Troupe.

"Notice: The Sweet Dreams Troupe serves as an outsourcing company for transportation, and SoulGlad Enterprise does not bear any liability in the event of accidents."

Nail of the Beast Coffin.desc: A section of a mech's bionic spinal column. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.
Nail of the Beast Coffin.lore:
The most important central component of the mech that was built in imitation of the borisin. Though the body that nurtured it no longer has even a sliver of life left, this component still maintains the "Slaughter Algorithm" inherited from primordial days and buried deep within its genes.

"While you see a monster that can never be killed, I see infinite parts to salvage. That's the difference in perspective."

A Glass of the Besotted Era.desc: A golden goblet of fine wine held by the troupe's cupbearer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
A Glass of the Besotted Era.lore:
A group of believers treads across countless stars, seeking memories of numerous fine wines, brewing their offerings in dreams. Another group of believers turns themselves into yeast, fermenting ancient faiths sealed by the dust of time, distilling their ideals within dreams.

"At this moment, a cup of nectar blends with a goblet of poison, intoxicating this era together and poisoning the future with the past."

Dream Flamer.desc: A flamer that instantly cooks food. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.
Dream Flamer.lore:
A special fiery dream flamer that uses flames to serve a delicious dream on the plate.
It serves as a tool for the Sweet Dreams Troupe's cooking, and can also be wielded as a weapon when they are transformed into the Dreamjolt Troupe.

"By design, the flames from this flamer affect only ingredients... although that doesn't exclude the possibility of the head chef regarding you as an ingredient."

Chordal Mirage.desc: The silver strings from the red instruments carried by the troupe's instrumentalists. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.
Chordal Mirage.lore:
A simple composition weaves shattered pasts, and the sound of music guides hope for the future. As the strings are plucked, countless worlds converge here — the laughters of this moment and the faded tears, the eternal wishes and the unfinished dreams.

"Pick up the memories buried in the ruins, and turn them into melodies."

Invasive Clot.desc: Black Tide Creatures' core crystal. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.
Invasive Clot.lore:
Truly, the followers of black tide appear in countless forms and can reliably be identified by their crystals. Yet, no one realizes that what seems to be the core is, in truth, merely the "outer shell."

"I saw a sea of crystals, and then — the relieved smile of the physician."

Radiant Prominence.desc: An alien crown left behind by the Noontide Gryphon. Can be used for Ascension of Fire characters.
Radiant Prominence.lore:
In a radiant fairy tale, Georios once sought the light of the moon to aid in creation. Aquila refused their rival's request, yet silently watched on, casting a sun-like gaze upon the land.

"The dance of the zenith sun and the night moon brings forth a perfect eclipse."

Sea Siren's Torn Fin.desc: Lady of Crashing Waves's spiny tail fin. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.
Sea Siren's Torn Fin.lore:
The daughters of the sea once had plump, long tails that glowed in the night, guiding lost fishermen home like lighthouses. Now, those fins have turned to bone spikes, piercing through the very chests they once protected.

"The mad waves of the Skiana Sea can reach a thousand meters high. The ocean is no gentle mother."

Thunder Strum.desc: A favorite instrument of the Rocking Rebels. An ascension material for Lightning characters.
Thunder Strum.lore:
Concerts in Planarcadia offer a spectacle you won't see anywhere else. Under the light of the Phantasmoon, the audience's soaring emotions actually manifest and react with the performers' instruments. Taming this physical emotion is a key skill for any musician here. Sometimes, after being soaked in that fervor for too long, an instrument might even evolve into a deadly weapon.

"Burn this place to the ground! Salt the earth! Burn this place to the ground! Leave nothing but ruins!" — A rock singer, during a solo concert
"Arcadia's a dream! The best place I've seen! The moon's out in bloom, and the air is serene!" — The same singer, at a gala hosted by Pearl

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: "Fortress of Dome" Eye of Twilight
Charred Bud of Twilight.desc: A corrosive core found within the head of a Dark Sun Gryphon. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.
Charred Bud of Twilight.lore:
The crown symbolizing celestial radiance collapses into a bud-shaped corrosive core. Beings of light succumb to shadow, while the Gryphon's searing hatred consumes itself like embers' fire.

"Light nurtures growth; darkness extorts death."

come_from: Stagnant Shadow: "Murmuring Woods" Grove of Epiphany
Darkveil Moonlight.desc: An alien crown left behind by the Moonlit Pegasus. Can be used for Ascension of Quantum characters.
Darkveil Moonlight.lore:
In a legend veiled by night, Oronyx once purloined the sun's radiance to bestow it upon the moon, as the Pegasi bore the brimming moonlight to ensure the earth's luminance during the slumber of Aquila.

"How can the moon's pallid glow rival the splendor of the sun?"

Harbinger of Strife.desc: The golden wheeled blade carried by Furiae Praetor. Can be used for Ascension of Imaginary characters.
Harbinger of Strife.lore:
Strife Titankins ascend through their ranks only via military achievements. This blade symbolizes exceptional courage, honor, and martial prowess.

"Plunge into death's River of Souls, and honor our god with your eternal fame."

Sneering Harlequin.desc: A clown mask that congeals the moment of greedy laughter. Ascension material for Quantum characters.
Sneering Harlequin.lore:
"What kind of joke could make the sneering ugly face contort into such an expression of laughter?"
When plain jokes could no longer satisfy, and easy amusement failed to draw the masses' attention, the greedy one remembered this mask. That roaring laughter once lacerated the corners of its mouth, its afterecho reverberating across the universe to this day. Yet he was famished, consumed by a desire to hunt down the ultimate "joke" to fill his belly.
Later, he got his wish and donned the mask. But in the vacuum-like silence, the only sound he heard was the unceasing chewing coming from his own mouth.

"The greedy must first devour their own tongues. Hilarious, truly hilarious, hehehe..."

Destroyer's Final Road.lore:
The leviathan's heart has stopped beating, but its mind lives on despite being trapped in a case. As long as the lid is closed, its mind is simultaneously both alive and dead, driving the engine of destruction.

"Doomsday Beast, a blight made in the Warforge using what's left of a leviathan and the weeping bones of thousands of the dead. It longs for the destruction of the universe and itself."

Guardian's Lament.lore:
Together with this visor, the twisted wish of a Guardian also lies broken.
She had wanted to find a way out for her people to escape the Everwinter, but ended up becoming a puppet of a consciousness beyond her.

"Supreme Guardian, the title passed down to generations of Belobog's rulers, the one who looked after all the people — It never occurred to anyone that the Guardians themselves also long for care and protection."

Regret of Infinite Ochema.lore:
No matter how many bodies it steals, its wish remains unfulfilled. Like those who seek the medicines of immortality, it craves an imperishable vessel, one that will rid it of its fear of destruction. And yet, it knows this is a dream that will never come true.

"I have seen countless worlds devoured by The Blemished One's conflagration, and I was one of THEIR flames. I danced at the twirl of THEIR fingers, keenly aware that should the fuel burn out, this fire will also extinguish..."

Past Evils of the Borehole Planet Disast.lore:
As a descendant bred personally by the Imperator Insectorum, its only desire is to expand the numbers of its kind. It uses giant scythes to harvest planets for its nest, tirelessly nurturing countless offspring, and devastating innumerable lives until the moment of its death.

"On the broken planet, giant locusts blotted out the sky, and swarms of insects poured out of the planet's crust. The stag beetle raised this new nest and presented it as a gift to its Imperator Insectorum... May this horror only exist in historical records, never to appear again."

come_from: Echo of War: Penacony Grand Theater
Lost Echo of the Shared Wish.lore:
THEY alone played the supreme rhythm until it was downed in THEIR multiple choruses.
Yet, THEIR listeners refused to fall silent. As the foolish dreamer seized the string of the shared wish, the false player repeated the music forgotten by the world.

"Stars trace your fingers and command all living's law and authority... Sweet dreams nowadays have manifested, and the gazillions of old laws have all faded away."

Auspice Sliver.lore:
Only in the fleeting moment right before death, when all things appear frozen in time, can the eyes of mortal humans behold the falling forms of these spiritual feathers. Flying Aureus, Spiritus — its speed is the greatest out of the seven forms of the Reignbow's manifestation.

 "I spent a dozen days and nights to hunt it, only to discover it has always been inside my body."

come_from: Echo of War: "Fortress of Dome" Eye of Twilight
Daythunder Anamnesis.lore:
When the child of humanity drank of the crystal core, they lost the gift to sense human hearts. From then onward, their only purpose was to watch over the earth, bound to endless cycles of stars and moons.
They continued to cherish life, yet could no longer perceive neighbors as living beings.

"Prostrate upon the earth, longing for the touch of blue skies. Yet, once soaring high, the humble fragrance of grass is beyond all price..."

come_from: Echo of War: "Memortis Shore" Ruins of Time
Vanquished Flow's Reticence.lore:
None remembered the sudden moment when the universe fell silent. The voice of thoughts dissolved. All shapes were recognized as identical pixels, captured by the anti-memetic web, transformed into a singular extrapolation.
Until it ceased to "speak."

"Core▀▄verdict▀▄█loop▄█▀entity▄me▀▄"

come_from: Echo of War: Desolate Maw's Demonhold
High Hopes of the Falsely Enlightened.lore:
The fools who lost their smile tirelessly play games with civilization, for without challengers there is no elation, not for others, and certainly not for themselves.
Yesterday withered, heroes died, and the evil villain traversed the stars, unleashing malice upon all. Yet there is still a yearning for someone to defeat the great villain and take the rewards prepared since the very beginning.

"Successors of Akivili, splendidly done."

Tears of Rail.desc: Congeals the corners once visited. Can be used as a substitute for advanced Trace Materials when they are insufficient.
Tears of Rail.lore:
Frozen tundras, restless harbors, radiant metropolises, and forgotten sanctuaries... These distant corners once visited now shimmer before the eyes like a mirage, only to be sealed away within a teardrop of interwoven paths.

"The ends of the path vanish into the endless starry sky, one side tethered to the past, the other leading toward the future."

Tears of Souls.desc: A prison cage that sealed life's essence and soul. Can substitute materials dropped by enemies when they are insufficient. The substitution ratio of Tears of Souls varies depending on the materials' rarity.
Tears of Souls.lore:
The ice-cold screws in the automaton's engine, the blood-stained fangs in the borisin's mouth, the withered finger joints on the Sanctus Medicus disciple's hand, the emotions jumping in the Memory Zone Meme's head... The various essences of life are all imprisoned within this tear.

"This drop of tear is the best proof that all life has a soul."

come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
Extinguished Core.desc: The heart of a monster wandering the Fragmentum. Crude material used for enhancement.
Extinguished Core.lore:
It is a lesion that breeds evil, the impulse to sin. It is the source of the Fragmentum distortion.
A heavy blow has caused this heart to stop beating and lose its luster.

"Preliminary tests indicate it's some kind of hybrid: One half is primordial, and the other half is something very similar to Stellarons." — Department of Biology, Sarah Castro

Ancient Part.desc: Mechanical part left behind from the Old World. Crude material used for enhancement.
Ancient Part.lore:
Despite its size, it was cast and polished in a way that people today would struggle to replicate.

"A small screw in the Old World is stronger than our armor."

Ancient Spindle.lore:
Once taken apart, the precision components can never be put back together. Even the maintenance veterans in Belobog's Technology Division would think twice before touching it.

"You idiot, the Bluecoats will only give you a few canned goods for this. Take it to Boss Svarog and you won't need to worry about food and clothing for a while."

Ancient Engine.desc: Mechanical engine left behind from the Old World. Advanced material used for enhancement.
Ancient Engine.lore:
It uses Geomarrow as the energy source. When powered, it spews wandering auroras, not sparkles.

"Only the Technology Division directly under the Supreme Guardian has access to information regarding the Old World. I lost my privileges after I was fired."

come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
Immortal Scionette.desc: New and young shoot budding from an ancient divine construct. Crude material used for enhancement.
Immortal Scionette.lore:
The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "infinite lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. Countless years ago, a sovereign's hubris for immortality caused the Xianzhou fleet to sail into the sea of outer space to seek divine recipes.

"We desire to live for endless ages and maintain the empire for all eternity. Unfortunately, human lives have limits and human capacity has its ends. Thus, we send nine Navis Astrigera to sail beyond the sky, seeking divine recipes for immortality."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword

come_from: Abominations of Abundance at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
Immortal Aeroblossom.desc: New flowers blooming out of an ancient divine construct. Normal material used for enhancement.
Immortal Aeroblossom.lore:
The source of the Xianzhou long-life species' "Endless Lifespan." The remnants of the Aeon of Abundance's influence. After endless trials, the fleet seeking the medicine of immortality was able to behold the visage of the celestial being. The divine one cast down its blessings in material form, and the Ambrosial Arbor sprouted its leaves.

"New buds descend into the moon, divine flowers bloom by the clouds. In the blink of a blossom's life, old wood returns to youthful grove."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword

"As decreed by the Ten-Lords Commission, all who are near the mara-struck state will be seized by the infernal judges and cast into the Shackling Prison."

light_cones: I Shall Be My Own Sword

come_from: Dropped by enemies in Divergent Universe
Artifex's Module.desc: Components used in Xianzhou's ingenium creations. Crude material used for enhancement.
Artifex's Module.lore:
The foundation of Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The smallest constituent of all machine parts. Breaking it apart would be akin to destroying the cellular structure of a living being.

"The Intelligentsia Guild put up a bounty of two million credits for technical plans that can flawlessly disassemble Xianzhou mechanical puppets."
"If you know Screwllum, then these two millions are basically yours to take..."

Artifex's Cogwheel.lore:
The connective components used in Xianzhou's ingenium technology. The intricate and thin teeth of the cogwheels are as minute as mustard seeds, and yet are interconnected to form a complex body, making the machine able to pass as true life.

Tatters of Thought.desc: A memoria fragment of fleeting thought. Crude material used for enhancement.
Tatters of Thought.lore:
Within the Memory Zone, thousands of thoughts flutter like dust. Broken thoughts accumulate, serving as nourishment and components for memes.

"A fleeting thought may dissipate into thin air or amass into obsessions."

come_from: Memory Zone Meme at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher

Fragments of Impression.desc: A memoria fragment of profound impression. Normal material used for enhancement.
Fragments of Impression.lore:
Within the Memory Zone, the form of memories float as fleeting glimmers of light, and only profound and memorable fragments can condense it crystals.

"Memory is not a mere replication of past sensations, but a reconstruction of past impressions."

come_from: Memory Zone Meme at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher

Shards of Desires.desc: A memoria fragment of obsessive desires. Advanced material used for enhancement.
Shards of Desires.lore:
Within the Memory Zone, memoria of desires develops ceaselessly. It absorbs thoughts and impressions, nurtures magic mirrors of desires, and reflects the eerie shadows of memetic entities.

"Memory points to the past, while desire points to the future. To seek desires from memory will cause dreams to become inverted, and inner demons will naturally be born."

Fear-Stomped Flesh.desc: Dust that forms the Strife Titankins. Crude material used for enhancement.
Fear-Stomped Flesh.lore:
The tide of death sweeps across the world, and giants of hatred and resentment step forth from the River of Souls. All fear and cower before that stone-carved legion.

"Slaughter is the stone from which fear is hewn."

light_cones: Flame of Blood, Blaze My Path
Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

Courage-Torn Chest.desc: A fragment of the Strife Titankins after their demise. Normal material used for enhancement.
Courage-Torn Chest.lore:
The slothful generals began to drill, and the reclusive sages began to plot. Then humanity discovered they could shatter the creations of gods, and slaughter became war.

"Fear is the chisel of courage."

Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

Glory-Aspersed Torso.desc: The heart of a Strife Titankin, full of divine power. Advanced material used for enhancement.
Glory-Aspersed Torso.lore:
In the beginning, humanity fought wars to stay alive, but now some fight as fearlessly as the Titankins of Strife to achieve death. The Kremnoans say that perhaps warriors of flesh and stone share the same heart —

"And this heart is called glory, with courage flowing within."

Long May Rainbows Adorn the Sky

Ethereal Omen.desc: A fragment dropped by black tide creatures. Crude material used for enhancement.
Ethereal Omen.lore:
Misfortune often creeps in quietly, and by the time you perceive it, it has already swelled into a calamity that engulfs the world.

"The death knell sounds at destiny's cessation."

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

come_from: Black Tide Creatures at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
Echoing Wail.desc: A fractured carapace from black tide creatures. Normal material used for enhancement.
Echoing Wail.lore:
Grotesque heads roar, ragged blades keen enough to sunder all, while the genesis of the scourge still lurks, veiled in the shadows and shrouded by the mists of death.

"Why do you lament alone at the gravestone?"

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

Eternal Lament.desc: A crystal born from the demise of black tide creatures. Advanced material used for enhancement.
Eternal Lament.lore:
Born of the void and destined to return to the void. A contorted existence wrought by decay, fated to wander the desolate earth purposelessly.

"Its life is one of ruin and sorrow."

light_cones: Life Should Be Cast to Flames

Whimsy Wax.desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A crude material used for enhancement.
Whimsy Wax.lore:
In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else."
"No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't."
The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes."
Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child.
For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world.

"With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

come_from: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 2
Dreamweave Steel.desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
Dreamweave Steel.lore:
Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?"
The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did."
Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence.
Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality.
Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind.

"With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

come_from: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 4
Lucid Awl.desc: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. An advanced material used for enhancement.
Lucid Awl.lore:
Every story worth taking seriously shares the same theme: "How to live the one life we're given."
Life is so short that even the greatest sages are suddenly tossed into this world, forced to experience a lifetime without any preparation. That is why no one ever lives a perfect life. There are always regrets, always moments wasted.
But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. And in stories, we can reach immortality from within our finite cages.

"With stories, we are able to live a thousand lifetimes."

light_cones: A Star That Lights the Night

Hertareum.desc: The cryptocurrency circulating internally in the Herta Space Station. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
Hertareum.lore:
Hertareum was planned as a digital currency, but eventually settled as a physical currency.
It's worth mentioning that even though Hertareum coins don't contain any precious metal components, the high-definition silhouette Non-Fungible Token contained inside it is much more valuable than any of them.

Shield.desc: The official currency circulating in Belobog. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
Shield.lore:
After a long era of blockades, the Overworld and Underworld denizens of Belobog have developed vastly different standards for currency.
The current exchange rate of shield to credits is now 1:50... Speaking of, why are credits still an official currency of Belobog? It seems people have already forgotten the answer to this question.

Strale.desc: The internal currency of the Xianzhou Alliance with strales as its basic monetary unit. Can be used to purchase goods in Special Stores.
Strale.lore: The Xianzhou strales have long been digitized before Xianzhou's interactions with the IPC ever happened. However, there are some collectors who still kept the Celest-Gold coins minted when the Alliance first came into existence. Shaped like the tip of an arrow or a narrow leaf, it seems to allude to the past and future of that civilization.

Clock Credits.desc: This is said to be a commemorative currency issued personally by the Watchmaker. Can only be used at the Clockie Statue.
Clock Credits.lore: A mysterious banknote, whose origin is unknown even to The Family. It features the classic image of Clockie on the front. This currency is prohibited for regular transactions in the Dreamscape world, and only a few people know its true purpose.

Celestial Ambrosia.desc: It was said that even Titans covet this ambrosial libation. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
Celestial Ambrosia.lore: The absolute finest of Amphoreus' thousand ambrosias. A golden, sweet nectar. It is said to come from the divine corpus of the Chalice of Plenty spilled onto the earth, making it the perfect offering to the Titans. Just a few drops are enough to inebriate a mortal with its rich fragrance. Consuming it on its own leads to unconsciousness, as if one is drowning in a vast ocean.

Disorder Ambrosia.desc: A liquid that exists outside temporal order. Cast it into the Tides of the Basin within the Vortex of Genesis.
Disorder Ambrosia.lore: A precious drink that was once considered "Celestial Ambrosia" in worldly cognition. As the cycles of Amphoreus were revealed, so did the truth of this drink. The scent wafting out of the bottle's mouth seems even more intense and sweeter than before, but imbibing is still not recommended.

Arcadian Token.desc: A commemorative coin used in Planarcadia and Astropolis, commonly known as "Wishbae." Can be exchanged for rewards at Furbobocom News.
Arcadian Token.lore:
The local currency of Planarcadia, minted and issued by the Wishpower Bank after being infused with Wishpower. The front depicts various imagenae living together in harmony. In the face of a digital economy, the Arcadian Token maintains its prestigious status among tourists and collectors for its unique blend of cultural sentiment and economic value.
Pursuant to the "Vehicle City Accord" ratified in Year 1985 of the Arcadian Calendar, universal equivalents tied to Wishpower are permitted to circulate in Astropolis as well.

Lil' Twisty Bubble Gum.desc: A tasty and cheap Punklorde snack. Can be used to Superimpose the Light Cone "Before the Tutorial Mission Starts."
Lil' Twisty Bubble Gum.lore:
A candy favored by a certain Stellaron Hunter. It contains rocket tree gum, and the crispy sound of bubbles popping is absolutely irresistible.

"Pop!"

Exorcismal Fulu.desc: The special talisman used by the Ten-Lords Commission to suppress heliobi. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Hey, Over Here."
Exorcismal Fulu.lore: "Decree of Nine Chapters, myriad spirits concealed."

Clockwork Inspiration Notebook.desc: A handbook that contains the Watchmaker's inspiration for his works. Can be used for the Superimposition of the Light Cone "For Tomorrow's Journey."
Clockwork Inspiration Notebook.lore: The initial director of Dreamjoy Memoir left this on the desk. It's filled with messy drafts, cryptic wording, indecipherable handwriting, and a Clockie's smile... The contents of this handbook bear the past of an entire world.

Music Disc.desc: The disc used during a band's performance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Ninja Record: Sound Hunt."

Physical Game Cartridge.desc: A plug-and-play cartridge. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Great Cosmic Enterprise."
Physical Game Cartridge.lore: Even with today's advanced data transfer technology, some developers still prefer cartridges as their game medium, just like writers savoring the sensation of pen on paper.

Chrysos Spoon.desc: A legendary cooking utensil used by fairies. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Forever Victual."
Chrysos Spoon.lore: "—With the power to control most of the Membrance Maze!"

Flawed Recollection.desc: A flawed, fragile crystalline flower of Remembrance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Fly Into a Pink Tomorrow."
Flawed Recollection.lore: "That genuine shiver when crystal flowers fall... That's the 'mover of life.'"

Commemorative Cartridge.desc: A game cartridge featuring the Baseball Raccoon avatar, the proof of a popular streamer. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone: "Tomorrow, Together."

Celebration Champagne.desc: The crisp pop of a champagne cork is like a victory salute. Can superimpose the Light Cone "Race to the Horizon."
Celebration Champagne.lore:
In the euphoria of victory, it is uncorked atop the podium, shaken, and sent spraying into the sky. A fragrant, fruity rain.

"Pop!"

Aideen Tokens.lore:
A token for amusement facilities at Aideen Park. Despite their large size, they are exceptionally lightweight.

Q: What is something that the more you possess, the less wealth you have? A: Gambler's chips.

Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Forgotte.desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Forgotten Hall this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Forgotte.lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Pure Fic.desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Pure Fiction this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Pure Fic.lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Apocalyp.desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in all stages of Apocalyptic Shadow this period, and obtaining the Prismatic Star in the Starward Mode stage.
Limited-Time Clearance Medal of Apocalyp.lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

Anomaly Arbitration Limited-Time Clearan.desc: Obtain this medal after achieving 3 stars in the King Stage of Anomaly Arbitration of this period.
Anomaly Arbitration Limited-Time Clearan.lore: Guided by the starlight, you reached the end of a path few have ever traveled.

Access Card.desc: Can be used to open the Relic Chest in the mysterious collection at Herta Space Station.
Access Card.lore: An unassuming card that can unlock Herta Space Station's most secure vault. If used wisely, it could lead to long-lost treasures.

Solid Water.lore:
Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. 
Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry.

"...Isn't it ice?"
"No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state."
"...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

come_from: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
Basic Ingredients.lore:
Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal.
Not particularly good, but is edible.

"Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

come_from: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies

Phlogiston.lore:
Particles that form the flame.
Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it.
#7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence.

"Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

come_from: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
Metal.lore:
A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean.
Very useful, very handy.

"I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

come_from: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
Gaseous Liquid.lore:
Is it fog, rain, or wind?
You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid.

"The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..."
"The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

come_from: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
Seed.lore:
Reproductive units unique to plants.
Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good.

"Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

Discarded Ingenium Parts.lore:
To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful.

"It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

Human-Height Auspicious Crops.lore:
The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere.

"The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
Tranquility.lore:
After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days.

"Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
Broken Dreams.lore:
Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony.
They once belonged to broken hearts.

"In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

come_from: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
Rusty Gear.lore:
Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities.

"The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

come_from: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
Distinctive Tattered Feather.lore:
A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. 

"If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!"
"...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

Mechanical Parts.lore:
Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions.
Without them, nothing can be made.

"With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day."
"Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

Virtual Particle.lore:
Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory.
Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality.

"I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

Protein Rice.lore:
Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives.
Smooth as egg white and full of protein.

"Every grain costs sweat and blood."
